use_scope: research and evaluation; not an unrestricted commercial license

modifications: Add _project_inputs hook for the seven independent first projections after optional unpadding; forward consumes its outputs while second f/g linears remain at their original stages. No recurrence, convolution, cache, initialization, or parameter-key changes.

Add _chunk_recurrence and _recurrent_recurrence dispatch hooks; forward calls the hooks with unchanged arguments. The model execution subclass can select installed FLA kernels, state layout and backward recomputation schedule without copying the frontend or modifying any kernel.
Relocate imports of three common-delta/GLA helpers to .fla_compat; Triton kernels and recurrence arithmetic unchanged.
Local API adapter: transpose_state_layout -> state_v_first; require and remove use_exp2=True because installed fla-core helpers already use exp2. No tensor transformations.

integration: Official fused-recurrent kernel copied byte-for-byte. Mixer has a documented input-projection hook; chunk kernel has two helper-import relocations to the fla-core 0.5.2 compatibility adapter. The optional fused model subclass packs existing independent Parameters each forward; no persistent packed weights.

runtime_requirements.FLA_CONV_BACKEND: unset or triton; model wrapper rejects other effective backends
